verdict.rationale: Gitleaks is a security scanner, so container-image vulnerability scanning is a fair question for this kind of tool. However, the evidence only documents secret detection in git repos, directories/files and stdin. Nothing shows scanning container images for OS-package or application-layer vulnerabilities, and Docker appears only as an installation method.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can scan container images for OS-package and application-layer vulnerabilities before deploying them
